body:
There are a lot of other features which depend upon this change. Default widget state/global state listener/virtual widgets (if they make it in) and I might be forgetting some.

Regarding the currentRefinedWidget, you cannot infer what actions resulted in given helper  state just from looking at its serialized representation. You can keep track of those actions, but without persisting them in the URL, refreshing the page will break the widget.

I agree that the current solution adds a layer of indirection that might seem unnecessary at first, but I don't see a better way to achieve the current set of features. The approach you're proposing is what I went with at first, before running into the issues I've described in #1170.
